convergence_status: NOT CONVERGED. v4 replaces v3's single 476 tok/s number with an honest split: the 476 figure did not survive the MTP amortization audit (weights are read once per verify cycle, not once per row). L_nomtp=730 tok/s is the sound ceiling for no-MTP ranking; the demonstrated 50.8 tok/s Q2_0 reference sits 14.4x below it. Closing the gap requires (a) a faster qualified implementation (U side) and/or (b) provable non-amortizable latency coupling (KV-state reads, serial chain latency that does not hide under perfect-draft prefetch), neither of which is currently proved. No pseudo-ratio is computed beyond the two declared scopes.
serial_chain_r5_analysis: Investigated and rejected for v4: a per-layer serial-latency term cannot be proved under the full allowed set. 'Arbitrary kernel fusion' permits a single fused dispatch for the whole 48-layer chain, making boundary dispatch latency an implementation choice; router-input reads hit just-produced data (registers/LDS/L2 under 'unrestricted caching'); past-token KV state is immutable and prefetchable. Every candidate latency coupling has a legal implementation that hides it. The honest convergence lever is the U side (faster qualified implementation), not further bound tightening under these premises.
